description: Publish a draft collection: it is indexed, sitemapped and announced to search engines. A curator may publish a draft on its own once it passes the gate and its list fits its name; retiring or renaming a live page stays with Tiago. Refused below 10 bookmarks under its rule, for a category or startups page without its own title, h1, lead and description, and for a startups page without its target_query or with a live page on the same rule. Curator only.

slug.description: The page's address, /collections/{slug}: lowercase words joined by hyphens, as people search for it ("yc-fall-2026", "a16z-speedrun-sr008", "defense-tech-startups").
